summary: My political science thesis in 1999 was to get a Kyoto Agreement signed was to have democrats push organics and family farms in cooperation with farmers in rural states. Only need to shave a few points. The 2010 census and Red Wave screwed that up.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
My political science thesis in 1999 was to get a Kyoto Agreement signed was to have democrats push organics and family farms in cooperation with farmers in rural states. Only need to shave a few points.
The 2010 census and Red Wave screwed that up.
